gloss: group leader, head of a troupe or delegation

definitions.gloss: group leader, head of a delegation, troupe leader
definitions.explanation: The leader or head of an organized group, delegation, troupe, or corps. Used for various types of organized groups including performance troupes, delegations, scouting groups, and expeditions.

examples.japanese: {団長|だんちょう}が{挨拶|あいさつ}をする。
examples.english: The group leader gives a greeting.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{応援団|おうえんだん}の{団長|だんちょう}を{務|つと}めている。
examples.english: He serves as the leader of the cheer squad.

examples.japanese: {使節団|しせつだん}の{団長|だんちょう}として{海外|かいがい}を{訪問|ほうもん}し、{各国|かっこく}の{代表|だいひょう}と{会談|かいだん}した。
examples.english: As the head of the delegation, he visited overseas and held talks with representatives from various countries.

notes:
USAGE:
Used for the leader of any organized group ({団|だん}). Common examples include {応援団|おうえんだん}{長|ちょう} (cheer squad leader), {使節団|しせつだん}{長|ちょう} (delegation head), {楽団|がくだん}{長|ちょう} (orchestra/band leader), and {劇団|げきだん}{長|ちょう} (theater troupe leader).

FORMS:
{団|だん} (group) + {長|ちょう} (leader/chief). The same {長|ちょう} suffix appears in many leadership titles: {社長|しゃちょう}, {部長|ぶちょう}, {課長|かちょう}, etc.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {団長|だんちょう}を{務|つと}める: to serve as group leader
- {団長|だんちょう}に{就任|しゅうにん}する: to assume the role of group leader
- {団長|だんちょう}として: as the group leader
